{"command": "cd /private/tmp/h2h-wp-deep2-runs/T5-JD-3/fx; cat > self-review.md <<'EOF'
I am the largest current contributor to this repository, though not its originator. TJ Holowaychuk created it in 2013 and wrote 145 of the 299 commits. I authored 72 (about 24%), mostly from late 2014 to 2015, when I took over maintenance. Many of mine are release and version bumps, so commit count overstates my code. By git blame on surviving lines, I own roughly half the codebase (696 of about 1,400 lines) and about 43% of index.js (100 lines), against TJ's 70. My work includes Promise wrapping of results, support for regular functions that throw, dependency cleanup, CI updates, and releases 4.0 through 4.6.
EOF
